raw_segments.text: I sat down on the side of the bed and commenced thinking about this head-pedaling harpoonier
After thinking some time on the bedside, I got up and took off my monkey jacket and then
stood in the middle of the room thinking.
I then took off my coat and thought a little more in my shirt sleeves.
But beginning to feel very cold now, half undressed as I was, and remembering what the
landlord said about the harpooniers not coming home at all that night, it being so very late,
I made no more adieu but jumped out of my pantaloons and boots, and then blowing out
the light tumbled into bed and commended myself to the care of heaven.
